notes: Permissive licenses compatible with the AGPL-3.0 project distribution; MPL-2.0 is file-level weak copyleft and compatible when files are kept separate.
MIT-0, 0BSD, Zlib and CC0-1.0 are public-domain-equivalent or permissive; they appear in AND expressions for bundled subcomponents (e.g. numpy).
OR expressions pass when any branch is allowed (recipient may choose); AND expressions require every branch.
Overrides require an explicit reason and are only for packages whose PyPI metadata is missing or ambiguous; each override must be justified with upstream evidence in docs/P2P_DEPENDENCY_REVIEW.md.
This policy gates declared license metadata; it is not legal advice.
